title: LONG2RAG: Evaluating Long-Context & Long-Form Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Key Point Recall
findings: Based on the Key Point Recall (KPR) metric, closed-source models like GPT-4o and Claude-3-Sonnet performed best on questions in the 'Religion' domain. Performance varied across all models and domains, with Religion being one of ten categories evaluated.
